bearingSource: OSM way 218412862 long axis 68.5°; +X points to the polygonal altar apse (ENE) at the narrowed east end of the outline; photos 02–04 show the apse with the small north annex next to the main tower, and the aerial photo 05 places the bulb-capped tower at the west end
approximations: No published dimensions were found. Plan after the OSM outline (34.4 × 11.5 m): 28.4 × 10.8 m body with a ten-sided altar apse; the small north annex is not in the outline and is sized from photos 02–04. Heights are scaled from photo 04 against people (walls ≈ 10 m, ridge ≈ 13 m, main tower cross ≈ 28 m, west tower cross ≈ 26 m); tower positions are read from the aerial photo 05. The south side and the west front are interpreted (south mirrored from the north). Brick ornament is reduced to archivolts, bands and a cornice frieze; window and door positions are approximate.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii de referință publice din 2025, ulterioare lucrărilor; dimensiunile și înălțimile sunt estimate, iar fațada sudică este interpretată. Acoperișurile, turlele și bulbul sunt redate așa cum apar în fotografii, în nuanța foarte închisă a cuprului oxidat livrat de COLOR METAL, conform evidențelor sale.
note.hu: A munkálatok utáni, 2025-ös nyilvános referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett; a méretek és magasságok becsültek, a déli homlokzat értelmezett. A tetők, a tornyok és a hagymakupola a fotókon látható módon, a COLOR METAL által – nyilvántartása szerint – szállított, oxidálódott réz nagyon sötét árnyalatában jelennek meg.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs taken in 2025, after the works; dimensions and heights are estimated and the south side is interpreted. Roofs, tower helm and bulb are shown as photographed, in the very dark tone of the oxidised copper supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records.
